config_path_hints: ~/.codex/config.toml (shared by the ChatGPT desktop app, Codex CLI and IDE extension)
ChatGPT desktop app: Settings → MCP servers → Add server, then Restart
notes: Codex reads TOML, not JSON: write the template as the table [mcp_servers.subkit] with the same keys (http_headers as an inline table). Streamable HTTP is the recommended transport. The stdio path requires `subkit login` on the local machine first; the proxy reads SUBKIT_API_KEY / SUBKIT_ENGINE_URL / ~/.subkit/config.json.
